title: TELL Server Monospace ANSI Profile, Headless TUI & Host Observability Baseline
non_scope: distributed inference runtime implementation or dynamic model loading daemons
full heterogeneous compute benchmarking suite execution across tell hardware
live SSE telemetry streaming daemon implementation
NixOS system reconfiguration or unmanaged daemon deployment
acceptance_criteria: Monospace ANSI 16-color and 24-bit TrueColor palettes implemented for headless server profile (surface.tell.server, KAD_PROFILE_SERVER)
High-density terminal status meters and compact ASCII/ANSI views render telemetry without graphical or audio dependencies
Host-specific capability adapter contract defined for host.tell.server without leaking NixOS package managers or system paths into cognition policy
Instant 0ms animation overhead and strict NO_AUDIO_UI verified
Deterministic contrast validation on standard ANSI black/dark backgrounds exceeds 14:1
Zero graphical or X11/Wayland dependencies verified over headless SSH and PTY multiplexers
Zero mutation authority over production routing or canonical vault verified
Full test suite, ISA checks, and doctor diagnostics remain GREEN
description: Harden the headless server presentation layer on tell (NixOS homelab node) with pure 16-color ANSI / 24-bit TrueColor monospace TUI profiles, 0ms latency, zero GUI/audio dependencies, and establish the minimal host capability adapter contract required for compute fabric node discovery.
